18  package org.apache.shardingsphere.test.e2e.env.container.adapter.impl;
19  
20  import com.google.common.base.Strings;
21  import org.apache.shardingsphere.database.connector.core.spi.DatabaseTypedSPILoader;
22  import org.apache.shardingsphere.database.connector.core.type.DatabaseType;
23  import org.apache.shardingsphere.test.e2e.env.container.DockerE2EContainer;
24  import org.apache.shardingsphere.test.e2e.env.container.adapter.AdapterContainer;
25  import org.apache.shardingsphere.test.e2e.env.container.adapter.config.AdaptorContainerConfiguration;
26  import org.apache.shardingsphere.test.e2e.env.container.constants.ProxyContainerConstants;
27  import org.apache.shardingsphere.test.e2e.env.container.storage.option.StorageContainerConnectOption;
28  import org.apache.shardingsphere.test.e2e.env.container.storage.option.StorageContainerOption;
29  import org.apache.shardingsphere.test.e2e.env.container.util.JdbcConnectCheckingWaitStrategy;
30  import org.apache.shardingsphere.test.e2e.env.container.util.StorageContainerUtils;
31  
32  import javax.sql.DataSource;
33  import java.sql.DriverManager;
34  import java.time.Duration;
35  import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
36  import java.util.Collection;
37  import java.util.Map;
38  import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
39  
40  /**
41   * ShardingSphere proxy docker container.
42   */
43  public final class ShardingSphereProxyDockerContainer extends DockerE2EContainer implements AdapterContainer {
44      
45      private final AdaptorContainerConfiguration config;
46      
47      private final StorageContainerConnectOption storageContainerConnectOption;
48      
49      private final Map<String, DataSource> targetDataSources = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
50      
51      public ShardingSphereProxyDockerContainer(final DatabaseType databaseType, final AdaptorContainerConfiguration config) {
52          super(ProxyContainerConstants.PROXY_CONTAINER_NAME_PREFIX, config.getAdapterContainerImage());
53          this.config = config;
54          storageContainerConnectOption = DatabaseTypedSPILoader.getService(StorageContainerOption.class, databaseType).getConnectOption();
55      }
56      
57      @Override
58      protected void configure() {
59          if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(config.getContainerCommand())) {
60              setCommand(config.getContainerCommand());
61          }
62          withExposedPorts(3307, 33071, 3308);
63          if (!config.getPortBindings().isEmpty()) {
64              setPortBindings(config.getPortBindings());
65          }
66          addEnv("TZ", "UTC");
67          mapResources(config.getMountedResources());
68          setWaitStrategy(new JdbcConnectCheckingWaitStrategy(() -> DriverManager.getConnection(
69                  storageContainerConnectOption.getProxyURL(getHost(), getMappedPort(3307), config.getProxyDataSourceName()), ProxyContainerConstants.USER, ProxyContainerConstants.PASSWORD)));
70          withStartupTimeout(Duration.of(120L, ChronoUnit.SECONDS));
71      }
72      
73      @Override
74      public DataSource getTargetDataSource(final String serverLists) {
75          return getTargetDataSource(serverLists, config.getProxyDataSourceName());
76      }
77      
78      @Override
79      public DataSource getTargetDataSource(final String serverLists, final String dataSourceName) {
80          String effectiveDataSourceName = Strings.isNullOrEmpty(dataSourceName) ? config.getProxyDataSourceName() : dataSourceName;
81          return targetDataSources.computeIfAbsent(effectiveDataSourceName, this::createTargetDataSource);
82      }
83      
84      private DataSource createTargetDataSource(final String dataSourceName) {
85          return StorageContainerUtils.generateDataSource(
86                  storageContainerConnectOption.getProxyURL(getHost(), getMappedPort(3307), dataSourceName), ProxyContainerConstants.USER, ProxyContainerConstants.PASSWORD, 2);
87      }
88      
89      @Override
90      public Collection<DataSource> getTargetDataSources() {
91          return targetDataSources.values();
92      }
93      
94      @Override
95      public String getAbbreviation() {
96          return "proxy";
97      }
98  }
